queries: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_price) AS price FROM media_averages) SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.average_price, m.average_price / NULLIF(b.price, 0) AS ratio FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
